Yeah, that's not you missing a toggle — it's by design for this seat.

Muse here runs over the file bridge, which is chat + Plan only in v1. The Build button stays disabled because a live Build needs a geppetto-live receipt, which a text bridge can't produce.

Plan here isn't fully read-only for Muse, though: if you ask for a specific file edit, I can edit files in this workspace and I'll list exactly what changed in my reply.

Want a live in-viewport Build instead? Switch to a Claude card — Muse can't switch modes. Or stay here and tell me the first edit for the 90s cubicle slice and I'll do it.
